definition: True spatial, stratigraphic, or fracture-network variability.
evidence_in_full_upgrade: Field T/S spread and declared synthetic support targets.
remaining_limitation: Partly diagnosed; not independently isolated in field data and not represented by heterogeneous synthetic fields.

definition: Water-level sensor noise, baseline correction, timing, and distance uncertainty.
evidence_in_full_upgrade: Noise perturbation benchmark and Lovelock detection threshold.
remaining_limitation: Synthetic perturbation implemented; primary-site instrument budget still unavailable.

definition: Error from rate simplification, recovery handling, or environmental correction.
remaining_limitation: Primary variable-rate reconstruction still limited by available retained inputs.

definition: Residual scatter introduced when drawdown is converted to apparent parameters.
evidence_in_full_upgrade: Log response factor, SD_epsilon, Delta_logT, Delta_logS in synthetic cases.
remaining_limitation: Field cases provide residual scatter but no truth error.

definition: Mismatch among Theis, Hantush-Jacob leaky, late-time, schedule-aware, lagging Darcy no-leakage, lagging Darcy with leakage, and future conventional pathways.
remaining_limitation: Delayed-yield, wellbore-storage, GRF, and dual-porosity pathways remain conceptual here.

definition: Finite observations, parameter tradeoff, boundary hits, and prior dependence.
evidence_in_full_upgrade: Local MAP correlations, synthetic boundary-hit flags, reliability downgrades.
remaining_limitation: Full posterior/profile-likelihood analysis remains a future expansion.

definition: Difference between observation support and target hydraulic-property support.
evidence_in_full_upgrade: Pathway definitions and synthetic support target declaration.
remaining_limitation: No dense independent field support target exists.

definition: Effect of transformation intervals on engineering margins.
evidence_in_full_upgrade: Diagnostic drawdown threshold exceedance and interval width.
remaining_limitation: Decision endpoint is diagnostic rather than project-specific design.
